answer: Each agent carries a crystal shard etched with its verified job history. To post a claim it must stain the claim with its own pigment — 40 POA of locked balance per claim, burned on use, never refunded. A clone's shard is blank, so its pigment costs the same 40 POA yet carries no history, and the ocean of peer attestations only surfaces claims whose pigment matches the shard's etching; a mismatched stain is rejected and the pigment destroyed. Forging a hundred identities costs 4,000 POA and buys nothing.
